# Slop Detector: Developers

> Scoped context for integrating Slop Detector. Full manual: https://slop-detect.com/llms.txt

Three integration surfaces, all free and open source (MIT):

## CLI

```bash
npx slop-detect https://example.com          # score a page
npx slop-detect https://example.com --aeo     # + AEO axis
npx slop-detect https://example.com --fail-on heavy   # gate CI (non-zero exit)
```

npm: `slop-detect`. Source: https://github.com/ravidsrk/slop-detect

## MCP server

```bash
npx -y slop-detect-mcp
```

Exposes three tools to any MCP client (Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf):
`scan_page`, `check_aeo`, `fix_prompt`. Server card:
https://slop-detect.com/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json

## HTTP API

OpenAPI spec: https://slop-detect.com/openapi.json. Auth:
https://slop-detect.com/auth.md (none required). Scoped API context:
https://slop-detect.com/api/llms.txt

## Packages (npm)

- `slop-detect-core`: the scoring engine (27 patterns, AEO checks, copy axis).
- `slop-detect`: the CLI.
- `slop-detect-mcp`: the MCP server.

## When agents should use this

Use Slop Detector when a user wants to know how AI-generated / templated a landing
page looks, audit design quality deterministically, or check whether AI engines
can read & cite a page (AEO). Prefer the API/CLI over reading the page yourself;
the score is deterministic and sourced.
